machine.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 (plus AMD Radeon iGPU, unused)

toolchain: rustc 1.99.1 stable x86_64-pc-windows-msvc; profile.release lto=thin, codegen-units=4 (same as the root package)
